title: How Low Can UiPath Stock Go When Its Numbers Are Not The Problem?
summary: UiPath (PATH) trades at about $14, some 29% below its high of the past year, and it has lost 11.7% over the past month. Its results are not what did that. The fall is recent: the stock is still up 34.5% over the past three months, and over the past twelve months it returned 18.9% against 17.0% for the S&P 500. What matters is how far a stock like this falls in a real shock.

title: Would You Want CRM Stock Back At The Price It Just Left?
summary: Salesforce (CRM) trades near $250 a share, close to its 52-week high after a fast three-month run.
